integrity: A self-contained proof and finite independent enumeration and determinant checks are included. Finite tests do not certify infinite claims. No independent evaluation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Single next-order factor only; q>=3; no pairwise correlations, mixed factor counts, or binary positive guarantee. General Markov-count formulas already imply pointwise marginal counts, but no inspected source states the sharp global bounds and complete extremizers; inaccessible older full texts remain priority risks.
title: Sharp nonbinary de Bruijn next-window probabilities and their unique extremizers
